clinician.final_diagnosis: ovarian schistosomiasis caused by granulomatous inflammatory processes surrounding viable and calcified eggs of S. mansoni
clinician.trajectory_summary: A 45-year-old female from a schistosomiasis endemic area presented in mid-2014 with strong left iliac pain. Initial imaging showed an enlarged left ovary with a cystic lesion suspicious for neoplasia. Tumor markers were normal and MRI did not exclude neoplasia. Histopathological examination of extracted ovarian tissue in April 2015 identified granulomatous inflammation with viable and calcified eggs of Schistosoma mansoni, confirming ovarian schistosomiasis, with no evidence of neoplastic tissue.
